stem: Which graph represents a function with a domain of all real numbers greater than or equal to -7 and less than 2?
visual_elements: Graph A: Curve from x=-2 open circle to x=6 closed circle, parabola shape.
Graph B: Curve from x=-3 closed circle to x=2 open circle, parabola shape.
Graph C: Curve from x=-4 closed circle to x=1 open circle, parabola shape.
Graph D: Curve from x=-7 closed circle to x=2 open circle, parabola shape.
notes: Answer choices are graphs labeled A, B, C, and D with various domain intervals indicated by open/closed endpoints.
